exposure: Location of ectopic pregnancy (ovary, tuba, Caesarean section scar, parauterine)
cohort: 40 patients diagnosed with ectopic pregnancy at a university hospital between January 2014 and January 2017, of whom 8 were evaluated by MRI and DWI
finding: Diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) may contribute to the diagnosis of ectopic pregnancy by showing diffusion restriction in the wall of the gestational sac (ring of restriction sign).
